what: Plate generation, reusing and managing plates
title: Plate Design and Management
text: PKbioanlysis simple database management system keep track plates generated. designing statistisfactory plate, can register database. can generate injection sequences dilution schemes. can always use print() created plate see metadata associated . Plate name can specified plate generation generate_96(descr = "plate1") modified using plate_metadata(plate, descr = "plate1"). first part plate ID unique plate , second part indicated reuse plate. can reuse plate calling reuse_plate(plate_id). find previous plate, can use plate_app() find retrieve reuse. Calibration study examples  can use make_calibration_study() typical calibration study instead using add_cs_curve() add_QC().  satisfied design, can register plates database. Finally, can use plate_app() inspect plates generate injection sequences dilution schemes.
code: plate <- generate_96()  plot(plate) #> Plate not registered. To register, use register_plate() #> Warning: Removed 96 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range #> (`geom_text()`). print(plate) #> 96 Well Plate  #>   #>  Active Rows: A B C D E F G H  #>  Last Fill: A,1  #>  Remaining Empty Spots: 96  #>  Description:   #>  Last Modified: 2025-05-19 16:43:03.350674  #>  Scheme h  #>  Plate ID: 1_1  #>  Registered: FALSE  #> NULL plate <- generate_96("Calibration study") |>      add_cs_curve(c(1, 3, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500)) |>     add_DB() |>      add_DB() |>     add_blank() |>   # CS0IS1     add_suitability(conc = 20) |>     add_QC(2, 200 ,400, qc_serial = FALSE) |>      add_DB() |>      add_blank(analyte = TRUE, IS = FALSE) |> # CS1IS0     add_cs_curve(c(1, 3, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500)) |>     add_QC(2, 180 , 400)   plot(plate, label_size = 1) #> Plate not registered. To register, use register_plate() #> Warning: Removed 48 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range #> (`geom_text()`). plate <- register_plate(plate) plot(plate) plate <- generate_96() |>      add_suitability(conc = 10) |>     make_calibration_study(         plate_std = c(1, 3, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500),          lqc_conc = 2,          mqc_conc = 200,         hqc_conc = 400,          n_qc = 4,          qc_serial = TRUE,          n_CS0IS0 = 2,         n_CS1IS0 = 2,         n_CS0IS1 = 2) plot(plate) #> Plate not registered. To register, use register_plate() #> Warning: Removed 64 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range #> (`geom_text()`). plate <- register_plate(plate) plate_app()
